title: Boarding the White Ship
subtitle: Pursued yet eluded; seen yet unseen.

items.text: Boarding the White Ship
Favela

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Listen up. We're the Apostles Brotherhood, not some worthless favela gang.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: So, we start off nice and easy. And if the doc doesn't play along, well, then we make her play along, clear?
A Shelter in the Favela
The feverish girl looks to be doing much better than before. Doctor Dores is crouched beside the bed, gently wiping her face.
A few uninvited guests burst in.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Hello. How can I help you, gentlemen?

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Ay, is she really blind?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I'm afraid yes. But please don't worry. I'm more than able to treat all my patients. Are you feeling unwell, sir?
Marcando glances at the patient on the stretcher and signals to his men.
His "dogs" quickly surround the patient.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Sir?

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: We heard that you're a good doctor. We got someone who needs your help.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: You're Dr. Dores from the Veterans' Residence, right?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Yes, and may I know who you are? I won't turn away a patient, but I'll also need some assurance that you can be trusted, sir.

items.speaker: Brotherhood Member
items.text: So, is she coming with us or not?
He kicks over a cabinet, causing the test tubes within to smash in a small explosion on the floor.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Did you hear that?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Sounds like some kind of explosion near the clinic. Should we go back?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: It could be an accident, but she's got a way with her equipment. Doubtful she's the cause of this.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Steady on then. Let's hurry back and see for ourselves.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Ah-ah, that's not how you treat a doctor, lads!
The thugs instinctively draw their knives—a habit developed in their line of "work."

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: What are you doing to her?!

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Lord Santos would like to have a word with the doctor, that's all.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: You're not taking her anywhere. Don't you see she's taking care of this girl?
She bares her claws, digging her heels into the ground.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Yeah, I'm not asking for permission, sweetheart.
Marcando snaps his fingers.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Grab the doctor. Ice the rest of them.
Kimberly clasps the head of a thug in her claws, poised to crush it, but she hesitates, glancing back at the doctor.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: Stop! Enough! I won't have you fighting in my clinic!
Kimberly releases her grip.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Doctor?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: But they've got the girl, Doctor.
The feverish girl's unconscious body has been thrown over the shoulder of one of the thugs.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: This lady definitely isn't from the favela. So, what's she doing here?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: She's ill. She needs my help. That is all I ever ask.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Well, all we need is you, Doc. So, how's about we make a deal? You come with us, we let the rest of your friends go, understood?

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: So be it.
She doesn't hesitate to accept.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Please, Doctor! Stand aside. I'll happily take care of these rats.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I have no doubt about that, Miss. However, once violence starts and blood is spilled, there will be no end to it. For now, I would be happy to meet with this Mr. Santos, and seek out a peaceful resolution.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: I'll come with you.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: See? We can all be friends.
The thug pushes the feverish girl toward Kimberly.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Vertin!
Kimberly catches her, holding her tightly in her arms.

items.speaker: Doctor Dores
items.text: If she doesn't wake up tonight, take her to the Veterans' Residence first thing in the morning.

items.speaker: Marcando
items.text: Alright, get the doctor straight to His Reverence.
A long sleep with no dreams.
No worries. No troubles. No thoughts.
Like being back in a warm, dark, damp room.
She awakes to an unfamiliar place. It's quiet and strange.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *cough*

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Have a good rest, did you, sleeping beauty?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Vertin!

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: You've missed quite a bit. All terrible, I'm afraid.
A talking ship inside a bottle.
A tiny floating fortress on the water, and beside her, a worried Ms. Kimberly.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Where am I?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: You and this lass were drifting down the river after your ship went down.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: You'd have met Dr. Dores, had you woken up a little sooner.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Doctor?

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: Dr. Dores, yes. She's a doctor from the Veterans' Residence. She saved you from the very claws of death.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: She ...
She can't walk. Her body is still too heavy.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Aye, you were burning up, lass. But the good doctor pulled you through. She was right there by your bedside the whole time.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: The good news is, we think she's still alive.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Still alive? What's the bad news, then?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: The bad news is she's been snatched up by the Apostles Brotherhood.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What?

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Rest now, lass. They aren't likely to hurt her, for now. You'll need your strength for later.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Some scallywag by the name of Santos wanted to "have a word with her," so they said.
Everything has gone to hell since that ship sank.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But Lopera and Sotheby ... Where are they?
There's a shooting pain in her arm.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I remember we all fell into the water.

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: I'm sorry. I didn't see them. I only—

items.speaker: Ms. Kimberly
items.text: We washed ashore together.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: My map—have you seen it? I have to get to the Veterans' Residence. They may very well be waiting for me there.
Come on. On your feet.

items.speaker: White Rum
items.text: Well, I may be just the ship to get you there, ladies.
TO BE CONTINUED…
